preprocess_images_for_llava_onevision: preprocess a list of images for the LLaVA-OneVision model with variable resolution patching and batching
resize_image_for_patching: resize an image to a target resolution while maintaining aspect ratio for patch-based processing
pad_image_to_square: pad an image to a square based on the longest edge with a configurable background color
get_image_patches_with_grid_pinpoints: divide an image into patches at the best selected resolution from a grid of possible resolutions
pad_batched_image_patches: pad a batch of image patches on the patch dimension with zeros so all batch items have the same number of patches
